_doc: A stampede's falls (specification 003 T008, Pwalkers-12, Prender-270): a blow of force 2 on the street corner at (60, 8), where people walk, with the clock running; who lies on the ground tripped (trips.cpp), fell forwards and put their hands out (Ragdoll::begin brace). Two and a half seconds after it, the fallen walker nearest the blow (setViewNear fallen) near (60 px a metre) from 40 degrees at four azimuths, mid (25) from above (80); by day. The first take, aimed at the corner itself, caught the fallen too small to see the hands. The camera stands at the corner before the blow, so the walkers there are drawn and each body falls from the pose its walker was drawn in (effects_bodies_census from_drawn, Prender-263).
